name: evide
description: Evide - Real-time group ride tracking web app for motorcycles and bicycles

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
